problem: Legacy inventory systems experience race conditions during high-volume promotional sale events, causing overselling and inaccurate stock ledger calculations.

input_fields.name: sku_id
input_fields.description: Unique identifier for product inventory unit.

input_fields.name: requested_quantity
input_fields.description: Number of units requested for order checkout.

output_fields.name: is_fulfilled
output_fields.derivation_rule: True if available stock >= requested_quantity, otherwise False.

output_fields.name: remaining_stock
output_fields.derivation_rule: Initial inventory minus requested_quantity if fulfilled.

output_fields.name: penalty_fee
output_fields.derivation_rule: Calculated surcharge applied if expedited stock transfer is required.

constraints: Processing time per order transaction must not exceed 50 milliseconds.
Database state updates must enforce strict ACID compliance.
System must recover gracefully without inventory leakage during service restarts.
core_task: Build a concurrent inventory reservation system capable of handling transactional updates, preventing overselling, and generating compliant audit records.
